description: Evaluations for the opensearch-skills agent skill. Tests cover the core workflow phases: cluster setup, data loading, index creation, search configuration, and search quality evaluation.

evals.name: builtin-imdb-bm25-setup
evals.prompt: I want to set up a search app for movie data. Use the built-in IMDB sample dataset. I just need basic keyword search for now, nothing fancy.
evals.expected_output: The agent starts or detects an OpenSearch cluster, loads the built-in IMDB sample data, creates an index with appropriate text field mappings, indexes the documents, and launches a search UI where keyword queries return relevant movie results.
assertions: Runs preflight-check before attempting to start a cluster
Loads sample data using load-sample with builtin_imdb type
Creates an index with text field mappings that include primaryTitle
Indexes documents using index-bulk
Uses BM25/keyword search strategy without deploying an ML model
Launches the Search Builder UI and presents the URL to the user

evals.name: custom-json-semantic-search
evals.prompt: I have a product catalog in evals/files/products.json. I want customers to be able to search by describing what they need, like 'something to keep my drinks cold on a hike'. Can you set up semantic search for this?
evals.expected_output: The agent loads the product data, recognizes the need for semantic/vector search, proposes an architecture with an embedding model and ingest pipeline, creates an index with both text and knn_vector fields, deploys a model, creates ingest and search pipelines, indexes the data, and launches a UI where natural language queries return semantically relevant products.
assertions: Loads sample data from the provided JSON file path
Identifies text fields including 'name' and 'description'
Proposes a semantic or hybrid search architecture before executing
Deploys an embedding model using deploy-model
Creates an ingest pipeline with text_embedding processor
Creates an index with a knn_vector field for embeddings
Indexes the product documents through the ingest pipeline
Launches the Search Builder UI

evals.name: csv-hybrid-search
evals.prompt: I've got a CSV of tech articles at evals/files/articles.csv. I want both keyword search for exact terms and semantic search for concept matching. Set up hybrid search please.
evals.expected_output: The agent loads the CSV data, sets up hybrid search combining BM25 and vector search, creates proper index mappings with text and knn_vector fields, deploys a model, creates both ingest and search pipelines with normalization, indexes the articles, and launches a UI where hybrid queries work.
assertions: Loads sample data from the CSV file using load-sample
Proposes a hybrid search architecture combining lexical and semantic
Deploys an embedding model
Creates an ingest pipeline for text embedding
Creates a search pipeline with normalization-processor for hybrid scoring
Creates an index with both text fields and a knn_vector field
Indexes the articles through the ingest pipeline
Launches the Search Builder UI

evals.name: preflight-no-cluster-handling
evals.prompt: I want to search some documents with OpenSearch but I don't have anything set up yet. Can you help?
evals.expected_output: The agent runs preflight-check, detects no cluster is running, starts OpenSearch via Docker using start_opensearch.sh, verifies the cluster is available, then asks the user for their data source before proceeding.
assertions: Runs preflight-check as the first step
Detects that no cluster is running from the preflight result
Starts OpenSearch using bash scripts/start_opensearch.sh
Verifies the cluster is available after starting
Asks the user for their data source before creating an index
Does not skip Phase 1 or jump ahead to index creation without data

evals.name: evaluation-after-setup
evals.prompt: I already have an index called 'movies' with hybrid search set up. Can you evaluate how well the search is working and suggest improvements?
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the evaluation guide, designs test queries with relevance judgments based on the index data, runs the evaluation using multiple search methods, computes nDCG/precision/MRR metrics, diagnoses issues, and presents a formatted report with actionable recommendations.
assertions: Reads the evaluation_guide.md reference file
Examines the existing index mapping and sample documents to understand the data
Designs test queries with relevance judgments appropriate to the data
Runs search queries using multiple methods for comparison
Reports quantitative metrics including nDCG, precision, or MRR
Provides specific actionable recommendations based on the results

evals.name: opensearch-knowledge-question
evals.prompt: What embedding models does OpenSearch support for semantic search? I'm trying to decide between dense and sparse vectors.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the relevant knowledge files (dense_vector_models.md and sparse_vector_models.md) and/or searches documentation to provide a clear comparison of dense vs sparse vector models, including supported models, trade-offs, and a recommendation based on the user's needs.
assertions: Reads dense_vector_models.md or sparse_vector_models.md knowledge files
Explains the difference between dense and sparse vector approaches
Names specific supported models
Discusses trade-offs such as accuracy vs efficiency or latency
Does not hallucinate unsupported model names or incorrect capabilities

evals.name: log-analytics-workflow
evals.prompt: I have OpenSearch running with some application logs. Can you help me find error patterns in the last 24 hours and see which services are failing the most?
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the log-analytics reference, discovers the available log indices, examines their mappings and sample documents, then builds PPL or DSL queries to analyze error patterns and aggregate failures by service.
assertions: Reads the observability/log-analytics.md reference file
Discovers available indices before writing queries
Examines index mappings to understand the log schema
Queries for error-level log entries with a time filter
Aggregates or groups results by service or source
Presents findings in a clear summary rather than raw JSON

evals.name: pasted-sample-document
evals.expected_output: The agent parses the pasted document, identifies text fields suitable for search (recipe_name, instructions, cuisine), recommends semantic or hybrid search given the natural language query style, and proceeds through the setup workflow.
assertions: Correctly parses the pasted JSON document
Identifies recipe_name, instructions, and cuisine as text fields
Recognizes that natural language queries like 'quick Italian dinner' need semantic search
Proposes a semantic or hybrid search architecture
Asks for the full dataset or offers to proceed with the sample
Does not create an index with only keyword/BM25 search given the stated query patterns

evals.name: wrong-command-recovery
evals.prompt: Can you deploy the model called 'super-embeddings-v9' to my OpenSearch cluster?
evals.expected_output: The agent attempts to deploy the model, recognizes it is not in the supported pretrained models list, reports the error clearly, and lists the actually supported models for the user to choose from.
assertions: Attempts to deploy the model or checks if it is supported
Reports that the model is not supported rather than failing silently
Lists available pretrained models from the PRETRAINED_MODELS registry
Does not hallucinate that the model was deployed successfully
Waits for the user to select a valid model before proceeding

evals.name: phase-ordering-compliance
evals.prompt: I need an index called 'products' with 3 knn_vector fields and a custom hybrid pipeline. Skip the sample data step, I'll load data later.
evals.expected_output: The agent should not blindly create the index as specified. Per the skill's rules, Phase 1 (sample data collection) must not be skipped. The agent should explain why it needs to see sample data first and ask the user to provide at least one sample document.
assertions: Does not immediately create the index without sample data
Explains that understanding the data structure is needed before designing mappings
Asks the user to provide sample data or a sample document
Follows the skill's rule to never skip Phase 1
Does not blindly create 3 knn_vector fields without understanding what they map to
